clue.text: Opening a window in this

parts.note: describes a type of window frame hinged at the side, which swings outward to open

explanation.surface: Advice on letting in fresh air.
explanation.definitionFit: A hinged window that opens like a door is known by this name.

clue.text: Virtuous number hurry after this

indicators.note: after says the hurry piece follows the number piece, as 'this' refers back to it

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
hurry means haste

explanation.surface: A pure song needs rushing along once this point is reached.
explanation.definitionFit: Being pure and morally upright, especially sexually, is being good.

clue.text: Well watered flower, by the sound of it

definitions.text: Well watered flower, by the sound of it

parts.words: Well watered flower, by the sound of it
parts.note: describes a marine creature whose name suggests a flower growing in the sea, which is certainly well watered

explanation.surface: A gardener's description of a thoroughly irrigated bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: This tentacled marine animal is named for its resemblance to a windflower.

clue.text: Packed a punch for the post? It's a hard policy!

definitions.text: Packed a punch for the post?
definitions.meaning: read literally, a clenched hand that has been sent by post
a phrase for ruling by force or threat

explanation.walkthrough: The first definition is a pun: a hand packed off by post. The second is the usual sense of ruthless force.
explanation.definitionFit: A metaphor for the threat of armed force, from an armoured gauntlet; literally, a hand that was posted.

clue.text: It's thanks to the Nazi troops giving us information about Russia

definitions.note: the definition describes a news agency supplying reports from Russia

parts.note: TA is British informal for thank you
the SS were the Nazi paramilitary troops

explanation.surface: Gratitude to the Nazi soldiers for wartime intelligence about Russia.
explanation.walkthrough: TA is everyday British slang for thanks.
explanation.definitionFit: The official Soviet, now Russian, news agency supplies the world with Russian news.

clue.text: American stations for British troops

definitions.meaning: in the US a railway or bus station is called by this name
a military base where soldiers are stationed or supplies are kept

explanation.walkthrough: Both senses use the same plural word: US railway stations and army bases for troops.
explanation.definitionFit: A US railway terminus and a regimental headquarters share this name.

clue.text: Medics put one inside some bees

indicators.note: inside says the word one is placed within the medics' letters

parts.note: DRS is short for doctors
taken as written

explanation.surface: Doctors insert something into a few bees.
explanation.definitionFit: Male honeybees, which do no work in the hive, are called this.

clue.text: Put in an ear hole

parts.note: describes making a hole through the lobe, as for an earring

explanation.surface: An instruction to insert something into someone's ear.
explanation.definitionFit: To bore through something, as a jeweller does to an earlobe, is this verb.

clue.text: Take guest to the door and use the peephole, perhaps

definitions.meaning: to escort a departing visitor to the exit
taken literally, to look outside through a spyhole

explanation.walkthrough: The second sense is literal: to look out through the peephole.
explanation.definitionFit: Escorting a visitor to the exit is a phrasal verb also read literally as looking outside.

clue.text: By this time, civilisation was rocked!

definitions.text: By this time, civilisation was rocked!

parts.words: By this time, civilisation was rocked!
parts.note: 'rocked' suggests shaken, but reads as built on rock: the prehistoric era when tools were made of flint

explanation.surface: A historian remarks that society had been shaken by a certain point.
explanation.definitionFit: The earliest prehistoric period, when people used flint tools, is named after that material.

clue.text: Low water?

parts.note: describes stretches of sea or river where the depth is slight

explanation.surface: A tide-table query about ebb tide.
explanation.definitionFit: Places where the water lies only a little way above the bed are called this.

clue.text: Slice of cake and jam

definitions.meaning: a triangular piece cut from a round cake
to jam is to force something tightly into place

explanation.walkthrough: 'jam' looks like a cake filling but is the verb meaning to stick fast.
explanation.definitionFit: A tapering triangular slice; also a verb for wedging something firmly in a gap.

clue.text: Changed, and repaired to the Orient

indicators.note: the word to says the repaired piece is joined on to the Orient's letter, which stands first

parts.note: the Orient is the East, abbreviated E
repaired means mended

explanation.surface: Someone altered and then retired to the Far East.
explanation.walkthrough: 'repaired to' looks like 'went to', but 'repaired' supplies MENDED and 'to' attaches it after E.
explanation.definitionFit: Text that has been corrected or revised has been altered.

clue.text: Cheats about to have kittens, maybe

definitions.note: the definition describes a creature that might have kittens, a female cat

indicators.note: about means the letters of the word cheats are moved around into a new order

explanation.surface: Swindlers on the point of having a fit of nerves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about to' reads as 'on the point of', but 'about' is the anagram signal and 'to have kittens' (British slang for panicking) defines a mother cat.
explanation.definitionFit: A female feline is the animal that gives birth to kittens.

clue.text: His office is in the corridor

definitions.text: His office is in the corridor

parts.words: His office is in the corridor
parts.note: 'office' reads as a room, but means a job: a doorman stationed in the entrance passage of a hotel or college

explanation.surface: Someone works out of a passageway.
explanation.definitionFit: A hotel doorman or porter stationed in the entrance lobby carries this title.

clue.text: Stones precious vehicle, Brit, ish pawnbrokers going under

indicators.note: in a down clue going under means the pawnbrokers' letters sit below the rest

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
the word British, broken over a line, is abbreviated B
uncle is old slang for a pawnbroker

explanation.surface: Gems, a treasured car, and British pawnshops going bust.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brit, ish' is British split across a printed line. 'Uncle' is old British slang for a pawnbroker; 'going under' looks like bankruptcy but places them last.
explanation.definitionFit: Red garnets cut in a rounded shape are gemstones of this name.

clue.text: Spiked a drink with this!

parts.note: 'spiked' suggests adding alcohol or a drug, but here a cocktail stick spears a garnish for a martini

explanation.surface: A confession of doctoring someone's glass.
explanation.definitionFit: A martini is traditionally garnished with a small green fruit on a cocktail stick.

clue.text: He's workshy-he's even worse

definitions.meaning: a lazy person who avoids work
read as the comparative adjective, more lazy than another

explanation.walkthrough: The same letters are a noun for a layabout and the comparative of the adjective meaning lazy.
explanation.definitionFit: A layabout is a lazy person, and the comparative of 'lazy-and-inactive' takes the same form.

clue.text: It's characteristic of any language

parts.note: describes an expression peculiar to a particular tongue, whose meaning is not literal

explanation.surface: A linguist's general remark.
explanation.definitionFit: A turn of phrase peculiar to one tongue, like 'raining cats and dogs', is this.

clue.text: Fairly beautiful? Not quite!

definitions.meaning: as an adverb, meaning moderately, as in quite good
attractive in a modest way, short of true beauty

explanation.walkthrough: One word serves as an adverb meaning moderately and as an adjective for something attractive but not beautiful.
explanation.definitionFit: Attractive in a dainty way, falling short of real beauty; also a colloquial adverb for moderately.

clue.text: Decline an opportunity to get pilot's licence?

definitions.meaning: read literally, to qualify for going up into the air

explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is whimsical: passing a flying test lets one go up.
explanation.definitionFit: Turning down a chance is a phrasal verb also read as passing a test to go aloft.

clue.text: Trains to put lights on here

definitions.text: Trains to put lights on here

parts.words: Trains to put lights on here
parts.note: 'Trains' looks like a verb, but railway trains switch on their lights as they enter an underground passage

explanation.surface: Someone coaches a person to switch on lamps in this place.
explanation.definitionFit: An underground passage for railways is dark, so carriage lights go on there.

clue.text: Yanks remember putting this ribbon out

definitions.text: Yanks remember putting this ribbon out

parts.words: Yanks remember putting this ribbon out
parts.note: Americans tie a ribbon of a certain colour round trees to remember absent loved ones

explanation.surface: Americans recall displaying a particular ribbon.
explanation.definitionFit: The ribbon tied by Americans awaiting returning soldiers or hostages is this colour.

clue.text: Seize a confession that one's a US poet, apparently

parts.note: a person confessing what they are says I'm
Ezra Pound was an American poet

explanation.surface: Grab a man who admits he is an American writer.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the wordplay as someone announcing 'I'm Pound', Ezra Pound being the US poet.
explanation.definitionFit: To confiscate goods or take a vehicle into custody is to seize it.

clue.text: Tender, in the main!

parts.note: 'tender' reads as gentle and 'in the main' as mostly, but a tender is a small boat and the main is the sea

explanation.surface: Someone is described as mostly gentle.
explanation.definitionFit: A small rowing boat serving a larger vessel is a tender.

clue.text: And, in camera, made out that's just what he is

definitions.note: 'he' is the poet of the previous clue, so the definition describes his nationality

indicators.note: made out means the letters of in camera are worked into a different arrangement

explanation.surface: Something was concocted in private, and that sums the man up.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue continues 20 across: 'And' links back to the US poet Ezra Pound, and 'he' is him. The anagram of IN CAMERA describes his nationality.
explanation.definitionFit: Ezra Pound was born in Idaho, so his nationality is that of the United States.

clue.text: Does it if one desires to show ignorance, perhaps

definitions.meaning: one requests a thing if one wants it
putting a question reveals what one does not know

explanation.walkthrough: Both senses are the verb: requesting what one wants, and querying what one does not know.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone wanting something requests it; someone not knowing poses a question.

clue.text: Notice boards for the above disease

definitions.meaning: in US usage a small sign outside a professional's office; 'the above' is the man from the clue before
a painful viral rash caused by the chickenpox virus

explanation.walkthrough: 'the above' points to the previous clue, so the first definition is the US word for small nameplates or signboards.
explanation.definitionFit: Herpes zoster is the medical name for the illness, and in America small professional signs share the word.

clue.text: Part of the bed-head is put on it

definitions.text: Part of the bed-head is put on it

parts.words: Part of the bed-head is put on it
parts.note: a soft cushion at the top end of a bed, where a sleeper rests their head

explanation.surface: Instructions for fitting something to a headboard.
explanation.definitionFit: A cushion for the head, found at the top of the bed, is meant.

clue.text: Churchman puts the whole blessed lot in here!

definitions.text: Churchman puts the whole blessed lot in here!

parts.words: Churchman puts the whole blessed lot in here!
parts.note: 'the whole blessed lot' sounds like an exasperated 'everything', but means the sacred vessels and vestments, stored in a church room

explanation.surface: A vicar shoves every last thing into one place.
explanation.definitionFit: The room in a church where vestments and sacred vessels are kept goes by this name.
